title: Project
description: Top-level entity that ties a user's request to every artifact produced across the pipeline. Mirrors persistence.ProjectRecord.to_dict() exactly - DirectorPlan/Storyboard/RenderPlan bodies live in IDirectorMemoryStore (queried by project_id, not embedded here); generation_job_ids/asset_ids are references into IGenerationJobStore/AssetManager. See docs/adr/0010-persistence-and-lifecycle.md.

rejected_stage.description: Which gate was most recently rejected, set only while/immediately after status=rejected.

brief.description: The raw user request that seeds the AI Director.

generation_job_ids.description: Ids resolvable via IGenerationJobStore, one per shot, set once generate_video has run.

asset_ids.description: Ids resolvable via AssetManager, one per successfully generated shot.

error_message.description: Set when status=failed - the generation failures that caused it.

render_manifest.description: Set when status=exported - the RenderManifest (render_manifest.schema.json) ProjectLifecycle.finalize_project produced. Embedded directly (unlike DirectorPlan/Storyboard/RenderPlan) since it's compact and final.
